conclusion: The course demand table mixes whole-day averages with single midnight records. All 350 present weekly query endpoints reproduce exactly as one record at 00:00 UTC.
replay_rule: From 2020-01-01 UTC, query through 00:00 UTC six days later. The next window starts seven days after the previous start. Cap the last endpoint at 2026-09-17 00:00 UTC. Group returned records by the UTC date. API returns one midnight record for each query end. This rule reproduces 350/350 present endpoint values.
scan_comparison: Separate nontruncated seven-day queries returned an hourly or finer series. Among 2,101 course dates outside the identified endpoints, 1,905 equal the rounded daily mean of these returned bins. This is a screen, not a complete high-resolution validation of all non-endpoint dates.
caution: Five-minute output grid is the API's resampling resolution. A complete count alone does not establish clean source observations. Twenty endpoint dates have fewer than 288 returned bins and thirteen contain values below 10,000 MW requiring further checks. Full-day means below are observed source summaries, not approved repairs. The prior cross-source estimate of 28,711 MW for 2022-08-02 addressed that day's additional corrupt early-night block.
